content.user_title: Manage MongoDB Atlas Organizations in Azure
content.value_statement: Azure Marketplace MongoDB Atlas setup needs precise ARM resource code. This skill provides .NET SDK patterns for organization creation, updates, listing, deletion, and troubleshooting.
actual_capabilities: Shows package installation for Azure.ResourceManager.MongoDBAtlas, Azure.Identity, and Azure.ResourceManager.
Explains authentication with DefaultAzureCredential and ArmClient.
Provides workflows to create, retrieve, list, update, and delete organization resources.
Documents marketplace, offer, user, and partner property models.
Covers long-running operation handling and provisioning state checks.
Summarizes common Azure and marketplace errors with fixes.
limitations: It manages Azure ARM organization resources, not Atlas clusters, databases, collections, or users.
It does not provision Azure credentials, RBAC roles, or subscriptions.
Examples use placeholder names, emails, subscription IDs, and plan details.
Marketplace offer values may vary by tenant, region, and contract.

use_cases.title: Create a Marketplace Organization
use_cases.description: Build the required .NET SDK data model for a new MongoDB Atlas organization resource.

use_cases.title: Audit Existing Organization Resources
use_cases.description: List MongoDB Atlas organization resources across a resource group or subscription.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Provisioning Failures
use_cases.description: Map common Azure and marketplace errors to practical checks for RBAC, names, and offer details.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Organization
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Azure Marketplace organization resource.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a MongoDB Atlas organization resource with Azure.ResourceManager.MongoDBAtlas. Include required marketplace, user, and partner properties.

prompt_templates.title: List Organization Resources
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate inventory across an Azure resource group or subscription.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how to list MongoDB Atlas organization resources in a resource group and across a subscription using the .NET SDK.

prompt_templates.title: Update Tags and User Details
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate maintenance for an existing organization resource.
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through updating tags and administrator user details on an existing MongoDB Atlas organization ARM resource.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Provisioning Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced automation with polling, validation, and failure handling.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a robust provisioning workflow for MongoDB Atlas organizations in Azure. Include long-running operations, provisioning states, and error handling.

output_examples.input: I need to create an Atlas organization from an Azure resource group.
output_examples.output: The response outlines credential setup, resource group lookup, organization data fields, marketplace offer details, and completion handling.

output_examples.input: I need to verify all Atlas organization resources in my subscription.
output_examples.output: The response describes subscription-wide listing, key fields to inspect, and how to check provisioning state for each resource.

output_examples.input: My organization creation failed with a marketplace error.
output_examples.output: The response gives a focused checklist for offer IDs, plan terms, subscription status, region support, and Azure permissions.

best_practices: Use DefaultAzureCredential and verify RBAC before running organization operations.
Treat create, update, and delete calls as long-running operations and monitor provisioning state.
Confirm marketplace offer and plan values for the target subscription and region.
anti_patterns: Do not use this SDK to manage Atlas clusters, databases, collections, or database users.
Do not hardcode production subscription IDs, admin emails, or marketplace terms in shared source.
Do not assume organization creation completed until the provisioning state is successful.

faq.question: Does this skill manage MongoDB Atlas clusters?
faq.answer: No. It covers Azure ARM organization resources for MongoDB Atlas marketplace integration.

faq.question: Which .NET package does it focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on Azure.ResourceManager.MongoDBAtlas with Azure.Identity and Azure.ResourceManager.

faq.question: Can it help with Azure Marketplace offer fields?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains the marketplace, offer, plan, term, user, and partner properties used by the SDK.

faq.question: Does it require Azure credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples assume Azure authentication through DefaultAzureCredential and suitable RBAC permissions.

faq.question: Can it delete an organization resource?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents the SDK delete workflow and notes that deletion is a long-running operation.

faq.question: Is it useful with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance can support coding workflows in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
